answer: Treat agent identity like a plot on a knoll: each agent must bond a small stake to a unique, hardware-verified device key before it can earn. A bonding contract acts as a prism, splitting vague compute claims into observable, attestable work trails. Then peer attestation drifts through like a zephyr — lightweight, randomized spot-checks by established neighbors that slash the bond of any clone whose trail does not hold up. Running clones then costs more than it pays.
